title: Robot Density Rankings Change When Worker Concentration Replaces Install Totals
hook: The country installing the most robots is not the most automated per worker.
closing: Robot density reveals worker-level automation that raw installation totals can hide.
question: Which robot measure matters more?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 robots per ten thousand workers. Its worker-level concentration exceeds every listed country.
The United States has 307 robots per ten thousand workers. South Korea's concentration is nearly four times higher.
China has 166 robots per ten thousand workers despite the most installations. Volume and worker-level density produce different rankings.
